name: APTDC Haritha Hill Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: The multi-cuisine restaurant at AP Tourism's Haritha Hill Resort is the single most reliable place to eat on Horsley Hills. Horsley Hills is a small, remote hill station — for most of the year the only real dining is the hotel-attached restaurants, and the Haritha resort is the largest of them. Reviewers note it serves spicy, tasty Andhra food alongside Indian, Chinese and Continental.
insider_tip: Outside peak weekends, very few standalone eateries open here — plan meals around the resort timings or pre-order. If the Haritha resort kitchen is overloaded with a tour group, the nearby Holiday Home also has a restaurant.
signature_address: APTDC Haritha Hill Resort, Horsley Hills 517352

name: Horsley Hills Viewpoint Snack Stalls (seasonal)
why_it_matters: The small cluster of snack and tea stalls that open near the Horsley Hills viewpoint and summit area during the high season and on weekends. With no proper restaurants on the hill outside the hotels, these stalls are the practical quick-eat for day-trippers — hot bajji, tea and Maggi in the cool hill air.
insider_tip: Strictly seasonal — they thin out on weekdays and off-season. If you are visiting midweek or in low season, do not count on them; carry food or eat at the Haritha resort. Cash; UPI is patchy on the hill.

name: Mandi House (Madanapalle)
area: RRN Colony, near RTC Bus Stand, Madanapalle (gateway, ~28km)
why_it_matters: TripAdvisor's #1-ranked restaurant in Madanapalle, the gateway town ~28km below Horsley Hills — a casual Arabian-and-biryani place specialising in mandi, kabsa, shawarma and Andhra-style biryani. Useful as the proper sit-down non-veg meal before or after the hill, since Horsley Hills itself has almost no restaurants.
insider_tip: Near the RTC Bus Stand in RRN Colony — easy to fold into the bus or drive between Madanapalle and the hill. Open 11am-11pm; mandi is the order, biryani the backup.
signature_address: First Floor, 407-2-2, CTM Road, near RTC Bus Stand, RRN Colony, Madanapalle 517325

name: MG Grand Premium (Madanapalle)
why_it_matters: TripAdvisor #3-ranked in Madanapalle — a contemporary multicuisine restaurant in the gateway town, with strong Mughlai dishes and ample vegetarian options plus Chinese and Continental. Its central location makes it the convenient family meal stop on the Madanapalle leg of a Horsley Hills trip, with more veg choice than the mandi places.
insider_tip: Better veg spread than the biryani-focused places — useful for mixed veg/non-veg groups. Central, near Sangam Function Hall; combine with errands in Madanapalle before heading up the hill.
signature_address: Opposite Rayalaseema School, near Sangam Function Hall, Madanapalle 517325
